
>  ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "container_client_key" -f remote-key


chmod 600 remote-key          # Private key should only be readable by you
chmod 655 remote-key.pub      # Public key can be world-readable


docker cp remote-key jenkins_con:/tmp/ansible/remote-key

ssh -v -i /tmp/ansible/remote-key root@client1_remote
